title: OpenXR Action Map binding cannot be removed when the action is renamed
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.6.stable


### System information

Godot v4.6.stable unknown - CachyOS Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 16 Feb 2026 20:41:55 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (nvidia; 580.126.18) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700K CPU @ 3.80GHz (16 threads) - 31.19 GiB memory

### Issue description

Pressing the garbage can icon next to a binding to remove it, will not work, with the error
```ERROR: modules/openxr/editor/openxr_interaction_profile_editor.cpp:96 - Condition "action.is_null()" is true.```
if the internal name for the corresponding action has been renamed.

The error comes from
```OpenXRInteractionProfileEditorBase::_remove_binding```
where it tries to look up the action in the action map based on the name.

There are several work-arounds:
- Saving the OpenXR action map propagates the rename
- Adding a new binding also propagates the rename
- Manually renaming the binding also allows deleting the binding again.

It's not a significant bug, but I figured it'd be good to at least have the issue and its work-arounds documented here, as it caught me off-guard. I think the fix would be to have the rename propagated as soon as the action is renamed, instead of requiring a save first.

### Steps to reproduce

This can be done in an empty project
1. Enable OpenXR; Project > Project Settings > XR > OpenXR > Enabled checked. Save and Restart
2. In the OpenXR Action Map tab, Add action with the plus button. Give it some name
3. In profile (e.g.: Simple Controller), add the binding to one of the buttons (e.g.: Menu click)
4. Back in the Action Sets tab, rename the action to something else
5. Go back to the profile where you created the binding and try to press the garbage can button
The binding remains and the Output log shows
```  ERROR: modules/openxr/editor/openxr_interaction_profile_editor.cpp:96 - Condition "action.is_null()" is true.```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[OpenXRActionRenameBugProjectFiles.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25416750/OpenXRActionRenameBugProjectFiles.zip)
An empty project with OpenXR enabled, and a minimal action map. Can also be created with the steps described above.
